history.summary: Bracket and sqft are inconsistent — a 1,119 sqft unit labelled '1BR' is a misclassification (this is a large multi-room unit), so the 'cheap' $1,162 PSF is an artefact of size, not value. Even so, D12 appreciation is weak at 2.1%/yr over 50 txns and the unit is a 20-minute walk from MRT.
history.rating_rationale: URA shows just 2.08%/yr appreciation on a solid 50-txn series — well below the ~5.8% RCR baseline and a genuine drag. Listing PSF ($1,162) is far below the $1,775 district median, which on a 1,119 sqft unit reflects an oversized/older-stack discount, not a bargain. 1.67km / 20-min MRT walk is poor for both rental and resale. Score_1000 of 709 leans on the low absolute PSF, which the sizing distorts.
red_flags: Bracket/size mismatch — 1,119 sqft is not a 1BR; sub-median PSF is a size artefact
20-min (1.67km) walk to Toa Payoh MRT hurts liquidity and rental
catalysts: Below-median PSF leaves some cushion if priced for the real (larger) unit type

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: D12 has decent tenant flow near Balestier/Toa Payoh, but the long MRT walk limits premium; yield likely 3% or below given the high absolute quantum for the bracket.
